briefdescription.para: Open circuit breaker to prevent cascading failures.
Document collection CRUD / filter / sort queries.
K-NN / ANN vector search (KNN, ANN, VECTOR_SEARCH keywords).
Full-text search (BM25, LIKE, CONTAINS, PHRASE, FULLTEXT).
Classification failed or query is empty.
FOR … UPDATE key WITH changes IN collection.
FOR … REPLACE key WITH document IN collection.
UPSERT searchExpr INSERT insertExpr UPDATE updateExpr IN collection.
Any text that does not match the above categories.
Log validation errors as warnings; return the query as-is (default).
Throw LLMException(INVALID_RESPONSE) when any ERROR-severity issue is found.
Re-invoke the LLM with error feedback; throw after all retries exhausted.
Plain text or structured text (e.g. HTML, Markdown).
Raster image (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, BMP, TIFF).
Audio recording (WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC, AAC, M4A).
Video clip (MP4, WEBM, AVI, MOV, MKV).
